title: Supply chain graph reconciler and release window planner for private-installer
author: Hannah Li
description:
Motivation: Private/on-prem customers operate under tight maintenance windows and constrained airgapped transfer schedules. Our existing release manifest generator produces large, unordered indexes which make calculating incremental upgrades and safe rollback sets difficult for operations teams. This PR introduces a supply-chain graph reconciler that produces deterministic, compact release profiles scoped to a customer-specified upgrade window and artifact transfer budget.

What this changes: builds a DAG of release artifacts (installer images, Helm charts, TF modules, bootstraps), resolves transitive dependencies, and emits two outputs: (1) a compact manifest profile containing only artifacts required for the planned upgrade window, and (2) a deterministic rollback index that maps the minimal artifact set and signatures required to revert to the previous stable state. The reconciler also batches signature requests to KMS/COSIGN to reduce signing latency for large airgapped bundles.

Implementation notes: the reconciler runs as a step in the private-installer release pipeline. It consumes staged build artifacts and provenance metadata produced by the artifact builder step and writes compact manifests to the releases bucket under profiles/<release>-<window>. Each profile is accompanied by a signed index and a small human-readable policy document describing transfer size, earliest application time, and required kube/helm versions. The algorithm includes heuristics to collapse duplicate upstream artifacts (same checksum, different tags) and to prefer previously-attested artifacts where available.

Checklist:
- [x] DAG builder for artifact graph
- [x] Window planner and size budgeting
- [x] Compact manifest and deterministic rollback index output
- [x] Batched signature header for KMS/COSIGN integration
- [x] CI pipeline step and unit tests
- [x] Documentation: pipeline README + example invocation

Backwards compatibility: the reconciler is opt-in and does not replace existing full release index generation. We add a new pipeline flag --profile-window to opt in to compact profile generation.

Related Linear tickets: ENG-5921 (release ergonomics for airgapped customers), ENG-7012 (reduce signing latency for large bundles).

release_notes: Add reconciler that emits compact profile manifests and deterministic rollback indexes for private-installer releases. New pipeline flag --profile-window allows generating small manifests scoped to an upgrade window to simplify transfers for airgapped customers. Batch KMS/COSIGN signing reduces end-to-end signing latency for large bundles.
